name: Follow up accepted LinkedIn connects
description: After lead-send-outreach connects: check pending vs accepted profiles and send a short LinkedIn DM when Message is available. Default dry-run — not in pipeline.

env.name: LEAD_DRY_RUN
env.description: When true, type the DM but do not click Send

env.name: LEAD_FOLLOWUP_MAX
env.description: Max pending connects to process this run

env.name: LEAD_FOLLOWUP_ONLY_ACCEPTED
env.description: When true, pending profiles are skipped (not_accepted) instead of recorded as pending

env.name: LEAD_RUN_ID
env.description: Lead run folder under data/leads/ (latest if unset)
